references.text: Nebo is mentioned as a Moabite city, showing the historical connection to the place mentioned in Numbers 32:38.
Nebo is mentioned in the prophecy against Moab, highlighting the city's significance in the region.
Nebo and Baal-Meon are mentioned earlier in the same chapter as cities in the area east of the Jordan.
Mount Nebo is mentioned as a place where the Israelites camped, in the same geographical area.
Baal-Meon (Beth-Baal-Meon) is mentioned as part of the inheritance of the tribe of Reuben.
Baal-Meon is mentioned in Ezekiel's prophecy against Moab as one of the cities in the region.
Baal-Meon is mentioned in the genealogy of Reuben as one of the cities where they lived.
Sibma (Sibma) is mentioned as a wine city in Moab, the same place as in Numbers 32:38.
Sibma is mentioned in Jeremiah's prophecy against Moab, with reference to its vineyards.
